# Contributing to Apollo MLED-1

Thanks for helping improve the MLED-1 firmware. This repository is Apollo Automation's
modified version of [WLED](https://github.com/wled/WLED) for the MLED-1 LED controller.

- **Questions and setup help:** the [Apollo Automation Discord](https://dsc.gg/ApolloAutomation)
  and [wiki](https://wiki.apolloautomation.com/).
- **MLED-1 bugs and feature requests:** open an issue here, not on the WLED project.
- **Security issues:** see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md); please report them privately.
- **Pull requests:** target `main`. Keep MLED-1 changes small and focused; the build
  (`pio run -e apollo_mled1`) must pass. PRs from outside contributors wait for a
  maintainer to approve the CI run. Maintainers merge with merge commits only.
- **Improvements that help every WLED device** are best sent to
  [wled/WLED](https://github.com/wled/WLED) directly, following
  [WLED's contributing guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md). Apollo picks them up when it merges
  the next WLED release.

Contributions are accepted under the repository licence, EUPL-1.2 (see LICENSE and NOTICE).
